segments.ja439:2.1: Sabbe apihitā dvārā, oruddhosmi yathā dijo;
segments.ja439:6.3: Ye ca taṃ anugijjhanti, te honti cakkadhārino.
segments.ja439:7.1: Bahubhaṇḍaṃ [bahuṃ bhaṇḍaṃ (sī. pī.)] avahāya, maggaṃ appaṭivekkhiya;
segments.ja439:8.1: Kammaṃ samekkhe vipulañca bhogaṃ, icchaṃ na seveyya anatthasaṃhitaṃ;
segments.ja439:8.3: Kareyya vākyaṃ anukampakānaṃ, taṃ tādisaṃ nātivatteyya cakkaṃ.
segments.ja439:9.1: Kīvaciraṃ nu me yakkha, cakkaṃ sirasi ṭhassati;
segments.ja439:9.3: Kati vassasahassāni, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja439:10.1: Atisaro paccasaro [accasaro (sī. syā. pī.)], mittavinda suṇohi me;
segments.ja439:10.3: Cakkaṃ te sirasi [sirasmi (syā.)] māviddhaṃ, na taṃ jīvaṃ pamokkhasīti.
